_comment: DSH global-memory Phase 3 GOLDEN SET (rework E1/E3). Synthetic content only. Deterministic stub vectors are derived ONLY from (cluster seed, stable id / case name) by tests/fixtures/golden-vectors.ts — never from record content or query text, so hybrid cases prove pure semantic (cluster) recall WITHOUT answer leakage. `mode`: both = lexical+vector expected; hybrid = lexical miss by design, vector path must find it; lexical = no query cluster, vector path skipped; neg = expected empty. `r-hard-neg` is a vectorMix decoy tilted JUST BELOW the vector threshold for `neg-hard` (hard negative). `near-pos` uses a `mix` query clustered just ABOVE the vector threshold (near-threshold positive). NO thresholds are stored here — the calibration runner searches them.

records.content: 用户偏好中文简洁回复，避免冗长解释
示例用户要求后台长任务完成时主动发送桌面通知
记忆插件默认关闭 embedding，防止正文发送第三方
测试产物统一放在专用产物目录，不写系统临时目录
the user prefers concise chinese replies over verbose explanations
desktop notifications are sent when a long-running task completes
embedding is disabled by default to avoid sending content to third parties
test artifacts live under a dedicated artifacts folder instead of the system temp dir
示例 TTS 语音合成服务运行在本地端口 8080，支持语气标签
SQLite WAL journal mode 配合 better-sqlite3 用于记忆持久化
bge-m3 model 提供 1024 维 embedding，支持中文语义召回
聊天机器人通过 webhook 发送消息，格式支持 markdown
puzzle game v2 战斗动画接入回合制宠物行动
音乐搜索优先使用官方权威音源，用户在意原版与翻唱版本的区分
宿主框架源码是只读基线，插件不得修改宿主源码
记忆删除先删正文再写无正文收据，收据只保留审计最小字段
向量召回距离验证用样例记录甲
